```sql
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT yearID, SUM(HR) AS total_hr
  FROM Batting
  WHERE yearID BETWEEN 2014 AND 2024
  GROUP BY yearID
)
SELECT yearID,
       total_hr,
       total_hr - LAG(total_hr) OVER (ORDER BY yearID) AS diff_from_prev
FROM yearly
WHERE yearID BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
ORDER BY yearID
```
